{{Infobox auto}}
'''Fish bones''' are a [[fishing junk]] item. They are a {{MCW|Bone|bone}} with a different name and texture, so they work anywhere a bone does, for example crafting [[Bone Meal|bone meal]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
* The junk table lists them at 10 of 78 weight in most biomes (12.82% of junk, about 8.01% of all catches in open water). These come from the loot table <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* 90.91% of the Sulfur Caves table, 5.68% of catches in open water in Sulfur Caves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>

Catching fish bones plays their own [[fishing sounds|sound]] and unlocks the Fish Bones entry of the [[Angler's Almanac]]. Fish bones from the junk table carry a <code>custom_data</code> tag (<code>version: 1</code>) that those from Sulfur Caves lack, so the two don't stack with each other.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/junk/fish_bones.json}}</ref> The [[Updating items|item updater]] adds the tag to any bone held in either hand that lacks it, renaming it to fish bones, so Sulfur Caves fish bones stack with the others once held. This also turns any plain bone, such as one dropped by a skeleton, into fish bones (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/item_modifier/modify/fish_bones.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Fish bones from Sulfur Caves now have the correct texture, so they stack with fish bones from the junk table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.4|2=Junk fish bones come from their own loot table, <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>. That table gives an {{MCW|Ender Pearl|ender pearl}} with the fish bones name and model instead of a bone (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref> The junk table couldn't be loaded, so they could only be caught in Sulfur Caves.}}
{{History line|1.12.5|The junk table loads again, so fish bones can be caught as junk, as ender pearls.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fishing Junk LT Fixed (Not for modded biomes)}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|Junk fish bones are bones instead of ender pearls, so they work as a bone, play their catch sound and unlock their Angler's Almanac entry.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref> The item updater turns any held bone without its version tag into fish bones.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/fish_bones.json}}</ref>}}
}}
